results.name: Positive-feedback GOF driver suppression
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting a target can break a positive regulatory feedback loop that sustains a GOF disease driver.
results.body: drug decreases target; target and GOF driver regulate each other upward
results.mechanism_rationale: Reciprocal same-sign regulation forms a positive feedback loop, and target inhibition is directionally corrective for the GOF driver.
results.trapi_notes: The loop is TRAPI-expressible; reciprocal node identity, SIGNOR provenance, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[forward:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[back:REGULATES]->(target)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(forward.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(back.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND forward.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND back.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND forward.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND back.object_direction_qualifier = forward.object_direction_qualifier
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Process- and anatomy-localized GOF feedback suppression
results.hypothesis: A GOF feedback-breaking mechanism is most credible when target and driver share a compact process and affected anatomy.
results.body: R200 plus shared compact process and Bgee expression in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The reciprocal corrective loop is localized independently by molecular process and affected tissue.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared process/anatomy identity, Bgee provenance, and degree constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[forward:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[back:REGULATES]->(target)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(forward.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(back.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND forward.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND back.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND forward.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND back.object_direction_qualifier = forward.object_direction_qualifier
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND EXISTS {
  MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process:BiologicalProcess)
        <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
  WHERE process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
}
  AND EXISTS {
  MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->
        (anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
        <-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]-(driver)
  MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
  WHERE 'infores:bgee' IN
        coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    AND 'infores:bgee' IN
        coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
}
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Dual-upstream GOF driver suppression
results.hypothesis: A drug is more likely to suppress a GOF disease driver when it inhibits two distinct upstream activators.
results.body: drug decreases two bound targets; both SIGNOR-upregulate one GOF driver
results.mechanism_rationale: Two independent drug-target arms converge directionally on the same explicit GOF driver.
results.trapi_notes: The convergent paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality, SIGNOR provenance, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.

MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(target1)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target2:Gene)

  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
